source: FTA Decision No. 3 of 2024 · FTA Public Clarification
headline: LATE CT
REGISTRATION

items: **New UAE or Free Zone company:** apply within **3 months** of incorporation
**Freelancer or sole trader:** turnover over **AED 1 million** in 2026 means apply by **31 March 2027**
**Foreign company managed in the UAE:** **3 months** after its year-end
